# Stage 20 Frontier Ledger

## Exact finite representation

For a finite graph with declared boundary and a boundary-rooted spanning
forest, relative tree normalization induces

```text
SU(2)^E / SU(2)^(V minus boundary)  <->  SU(2)^(E minus forest).
```

The coordinates are invariant under interior gauge transformations and
covariant under independent boundary transformations.  Normalized Haar
measure factorizes into quotient-edge Haar factors times the constant interior
gauge volume.  Splitting the quotient edges therefore gives an exact retained
state/interior-fiber disintegration.

## Sufficiency and minimality

Locality implies that an exterior conditional uses the block only through the
retained boundary connection.  Omitting any retained edge that participates
in a crossing plaquette is not sufficient: two configurations with the same
reduced state can yield different values of a nonconstant plaquette class
weight.

## Open extension

The full `2^4` nonabelian block must choose an overlap-consistent forest and
retained coarse loops, then construct the state weight and bad subkernel.  No
weighted defect ceiling or RG iteration is claimed.

Strongest level: `C2` exact finite representation theorem.
